card.name: Invitations to visit and learn at events
card.fires_on: Small words like about, and, to, of inside announcements that invite the public to an event, tour or open day to learn, talk to staff or see things. Seen after phrases like "learn more", "come and", "talk".

modes.label: Learn more about
modes.description: The word about after learn or learn more, in a public event or visit announcement.

modes.description: Linking words or nouns in lists of things visitors can do, such as talk to volunteers or see examples.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about opportunities, chances, events and the public, including some Chinese words of that sense.
card.plain: It fires on little words in invitations that tell the public they can come, learn and meet people at an event.
